fieldguide.entity.royalvariations.royal_:
A Creeper with a royal background. It can turn nearby mobs explosive, dazing foes as it charges up an explosion. It's more mobile than most Creepers, moving while charging up a blast. 

It can also be charged by lightning. Stay inside on a stormy night.

An Enderman from the high ranks of an End City. Their gaze is powerful, aggravating nearby Enderman towards foes. 

Their teleportation forms powerful rifts of energy, and they can even drop spectral anvils on the heads of those hiding in water.
A tough Zombie with a royal background. He equips nearby zombies to be his knights, and marks foes as a chosen victim, bringing them the fierce ire of the undead.

A powerful Skeleton with a royal background, they can rally nearby Sksletons, and even fire strong arrows that mark foes. Marked foes have reduced stats and draw the attention of nearby mobs. 

When struck, it traps attackers in a net that can be broken with a blade.
